TITLE: Emoji Mosaic
PREFIX_HELP: Name prefix. Each emoji gets a row and column after it, such as cat_r1c2.
NO_SERVERS: You can't add emoji to any of your servers.
TOO_MANY: {count} emoji won't fit: {free} slots are free. Use fewer columns.
UPLOADED: Added {count} emoji to {server}. The mosaic is in your message box.
